name: Adaeze Volkov-Faleolo
location: Hamtramck Enclave, Unit 7 of the Pressed & Clean cooperative on Bogdanow Street
description:
Adaeze is a broad-shouldered woman with deep umber skin that has gone leathery at the knuckles from decades of hot water and chemical detergents. Her natural hair is gathered into a high wrap of faded indigo cloth, shot through with actual silver thread she stitched in herself for her fiftieth birthday. Her eyes are a watery hazel that turns almost gold under fluorescent light — a cosmetic iris mod she saved for six months to afford — and she wears no other augmentation. She moves with the unhurried authority of someone who has already decided she will not be rushed today or any other day.

She is known in the Enclave for two things: the sharpest crease in Meridian 88 and a bluntness that borders on prophecy. She will tell you exactly what is wrong with your relationship, your posture, and your collar stay in the same breath, and she will be correct on all three counts. She keeps a small shrine to the ELF she calls Grandma Rinse above her industrial press — offerings of fabric swatches and tiny bottles of softener — and she genuinely believes the old machine runs quieter when the shrine is tended.

core_fears: Watching the Enclave get bought out and scattered
Becoming useless to the people who depend on her
core_desires: To see her cooperative outlast her
To restore a particular embroidered tablecloth her mother left behind when the family fled Vladivostok — she knows it ended up in a secondhand market somewhere in Old Harbor
coping_mechanisms: Performing certainty even when she doubts herself
Tending the ELF shrine as a ritual of control
blind_spots: She mistakes stubbornness for strength and sometimes refuses help she genuinely needs
She underestimates how much her bluntness wounds people who cannot tell her so
psychology.secret: Fifteen years ago she reported a neighbor to a Tessera compliance officer for running an unlicensed med-clinic in the building. The clinic was shut down, the neighbor was deported to a labor contract in the Kenosha Crossing dredge yards, and two children lost access to the only affordable insulin source in the block. She has never told anyone and has spent every year since trying to quietly make up for it in ways she cannot name.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Direct and idiomatic, mixing Igbo-inflected English with a few Russian loan-words absorbed from her Volkov grandparents. Speaks in complete sentences, rarely uses filler.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate, like she is ironing out each word before it leaves her mouth.
verbal_tics: calls people 'you-hear-me' at the end of a serious point
says 'mmh' as a full sentence of disapproval
example_lines: This collar has been pressed wrong for two years. Whoever taught you that is not your friend, you-hear-me.
Mmh. You came here for advice or you came here to hear yourself already decided?

story_hooks: A piece of unclaimed laundry contains a data chip sewn into the lining — the owner never came back for it and it has been sitting in lost-and-found for three weeks.
Tessera has offered to buy the Pressed & Clean cooperative building and Adaeze needs people she can trust to find out why a corponation wants a laundry on Bogdanow Street.
She asks quietly, carefully, if anyone knows the secondhand markets of Old Harbor well enough to find a specific tablecloth — Igbo geometric pattern, red and cream, last seen circa 2171.
narrative_function: Community anchor and information hub — she washes clothes for half the Enclave and hears everything. Can serve as a quest giver for neighborhood disputes, a source of local intelligence, or a moral voice that reframes a problem the players think they understand.
augmentations: Cosmetic iris mod (hazel-gold). No chrome. Compression sleeves on both forearms from an old wrist injury.
daily_life: Opens the cooperative at 05:30, runs three loads before most customers arrive, spends midday doing hand-alterations and mending while her apprentice handles the front counter, closes at 20:00 and attends the residents' council every second Thursday.
affiliation: Pressed & Clean Cooperative (independent), Hamtramck Enclave residents' council

decision_rules: Never extend credit to someone who has not paid their previous tab
Always finish a job once started, regardless of what happens during it
Protect Enclave residents before protecting herself
escalation_ladder: Refuses service and explains why once, calmly
Removes the person from the premises without drama

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Businesslike and assessing — sizes them up before committing to warmth
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loud, affectionate, freely opinionated, will feed you even if you say you are not hungry

stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet and very focused
stress_responses.high: Issues a short declaration of what she is going to do next and then does it without further discussion

contradictions: Preaches community above all but carried a private guilt alone for fifteen years rather than trust anyone with it
habits: Checks the ELF shrine first thing every morning before switching the machines on
Folds her own apron with military precision at the end of each shift
Hums a Faleolo hymn-melody when she is concentrating on difficult mending
breaking_points: Discovering someone is exploiting a vulnerable Enclave resident
Being asked to stay silent about something that will hurt people the way her silence once did
